config.label: Transport: 'direct' (default; sign locally, an independent witness co-signs) or 'managed' (route through the Sequesign broker for a registered identity)
config.description: Transport: 'direct' (default; sign locally, an independent witness co-signs) or 'managed' (route through the Sequesign broker for a registered identity).

config.label: Sequesign write-class API key (from the dashboard)
config.description: Sequesign write-class API key (from the dashboard). Required for managed mode; in direct mode it authenticates the hosted witness.

config.label: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private-key PEM for the agent
config.description: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private-key PEM for the agent. In managed mode, the key registered to your API key. In direct mode, omit to mint an ephemeral key per session.

config.label: Directory where sealed receipt packages are written
config.description: Directory where sealed receipt packages are written. Defaults to a temporary directory.
